title: A resume brief for a worker restates the landing's own checks before its next commit
goal: the sprint skill's run step says the orchestrator's resume request (claude -p --resume) to a worker restates worker rule 4: run land_stale, land_eval and land_lint before each new commit, Self-Reviewed named again for a doc the new commit's paths map to

run:
import sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
import re
ok=bool(re.search(r'resume[^.]*(land_stale|rule 4)',t))
print('resume restates the landing checks:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
